topic: A ₹200-a-day habit = ₹73,000 a year: what small daily spends add up to
hook_pattern: small-input-big-number (₹200 a day → ₹7.3 lakh in 10 years)
caption:
A ₹200-a-day habit adds up to ₹73,000 a year.

Coffee, cabs, delivery fees: small spends don't feel like much on the day. Simply added up, ₹200 a day is ₹73,000 in a year, ₹3.65 lakh in five years and ₹7.3 lakh in ten.

Illustrative only: if about the same amount, ₹6,000 a month, were invested every month for 10 years and earned an assumed 10% a year, it would grow to roughly ₹12.4 lakh. Real returns vary, can be lower, and aren't guaranteed.

Before you cut anything:
1. Track one week of small spends and find your own daily number.
2. Keep the habits you truly enjoy.
3. Drop or shrink one you won't miss.

What's your daily number? Save this and work it out tonight. Follow for one money fix a day.

Sources: our own arithmetic (₹200 × 365 days; future value of a monthly series at an assumed 10% a year, compounded monthly). Illustrative, not a forecast.
For education only. Not investment advice.
Voiceover is AI-generated.
